items.title: Realign stale assertions across all failing smokes
items.context: For each smoke that fails on a fresh main checkout under both `npm run test:all` (parallel) and `node packages/main/dist/tasks/<name>-smoke.js` (single), update the offending assertion to match current production behavior. Preserve assertion INTENT (what the test is checking) but match TEXT/REGEX/ENUM to current output. DO NOT modify production source. If a failure is rooted in production-side regression (test was correct, prod drifted in a way that should be reverted), file finding_add with severity=high and leave the smoke as-is for the follow-up story.

items.title: Diagnose + fix lattice-baseline TIMEOUT
items.context: lattice-baseline-smoke times out at the 60s default. Three possible causes: (a) genuinely slow → raise smoke-manifest.json timeoutMs entry for this smoke only; (b) deadlock/hang → file finding + investigate; (c) parallel-race → mark with skipUnderParallel or convert to require --jobs 1. Pick the right remedy; document choice in CHANGELOG.
